name: Lemon Squeezy
summary: Lemon Squeezy is a merchant of record owned by Stripe that charges 5% plus 50 cents per transaction, with surcharges for international cards, PayPal and subscription payments. Its January 2026 update said it aims to move users to Stripe Managed Payments.

facts.text: Stripe acquired Lemon Squeezy in July 2024, and Lemon Squeezy had processed its payments on Stripe since it began.
Lemon Squeezy's January 2026 update said its goal is an easy migration to Stripe Managed Payments and acknowledged slower support responses and less frequent product updates.
Card statements show LEMSQZY* followed by the store name, because Lemon Squeezy is the merchant of record.
Failed subscription payments are retried four times over two weeks, and renewal reminders go out seven days ahead.
Net sales are held for 13 days and paid out on the 1st and 15th of each month, with a $50 minimum.
The terms make sellers responsible for copying their data before termination. We found no documented way to move saved cards out to another provider.

hiddenCosts: Transactions outside the US add 1.5%, and PayPal transactions add 1.5%.
Payments recovered through abandoned cart emails add 5%.
Disputes cost $15 each, and the platform fee is kept when an order is refunded.
Bank payouts outside the US cost 1% per payout.

contract.cancellation: Lemon Squeezy can delay payouts, suspend accounts and refund payouts without warning if there is evidence of fraud.
contract.dataExport: Subscriptions and subscription invoices as CSV.
